newsitem.title: USA: Elbit finalizes Inframetrics stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Elbit finalizes Inframetrics stake sale.

text.p: Israel's Elbit Ltd said on Tuesday it signed a previously announced agreement to sell 80 percent of its Inframetrics Inc subsidiary to an investor group led by Advent International Corp.

Elbit said in a statement it signed a deal to sell the Massachusetts-based unit to a group which also included Inframetrics' management. It had announced its intention to sell the stake on September 3.
Elbit said it would receive $29.7 million, including $18.7 million in cash and $11 million in a note with annual interest of 8 percent, and payable on September 30, 2003.
Under the agreement, Elbit said its stake in Inframetrics will be reduced to 20 percent and it would have the right to nominate one of Inframetrics' seven board members.
The purchasers have retained an option to buy the remaining 20 percent of the unit for $10 million, it said.

The transaction would give Elbit a one-time profit of about $10 million, to be reported in the third quarter, it said. It also said expected to record undisclosed expenses and one-time charges in connection with its planned demerger and the reorganization of its business.
Inframetrics manufactures thermal imaging and thermography systems for industrial applications, observation systems, border surveillance and other uses.
